text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... That was one long race... Real long...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sure, 3,200 meters is a helluva distance,
Kyoto
or otherwise... But includin' the
journey to get
here? I feel like I've been
runnin' for ages.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I did it... I finally did it! I finished the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Didja see dat, Dad?! Your girl left her
mark on
this turf!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spectators echo Tamamo Cross's
enthusiasm.
Meanwhile, a certain
Umamusume watches in
awe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This is... incredible...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not even top fashion brands draw this
much
excitement at their shows. But
this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So this is what the senior G1 races of the
Twinkle
Series are like... No, that's not
right...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: This is all Tamamo's doing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross has triggered a
groundswell of
support the likes of
which nobody has ever seen
before—and
it's only growing stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, things are finally calmin' down.
Trainer, I
did pretty well for myself,
dont'cha think?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know, right? White Lightning
sure lit up
that big ol' stage. And I
couldn't have done it
without you!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But we're just gettin' started. I can't say
my
dream's come true till I've dominated
the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So it's time to do this! Mom, Dad, the li'l
squirts...
We can't let any of 'em cry
another tear!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen! I'll
make a name
for myself this spring, 'n
then it'll be time to
tackle the big one in
the fall!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzzt...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm, what the? Who could that be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's phone begins to vibrate,
so she
answers the call.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That you, Mom? What's wrong? We just
talked
yesterday, 'n it's kinda late for a
chat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You findin' work okay? Did somethin'
happen?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No... That can't be right... Just
yesterday, he was
so full of life...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This... can't be real...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She stares ahead. Shocked to the core,
Tamamo
Cross is frozen in place.
